extensions.description: Extensions for grantable rewards (Rewards that can appear in a shop or as a trial reward).

is_service_merchant_reward.description: Whether this is a service merchant reward.

merchant_service_index.description: Applicable if is_service_merchant_reward is true, Index of the merchant service for this reward.

apply_trial_data_modifiers.description: Applicable to gold rewards, Whether to apply trial data modifiers to this reward.
